integrity: The embedded Python verifier is self-contained; arithmetic chamber realizability and finite-field universality also use a mathematical argument and established del Pezzo classification, not only enumerations.
scientific_limitations: Classification is of the finite Galois set of geometric Zariski chambers, not of rational divisor classes or the surface zeta function. Earlier work contains the geometric total 76 and full S5 form classification. Historical priority is provisional; independent mathematical review was not performed.
title: Frobenius descent and zeta spectra of Zariski chambers on degree-five del Pezzo surfaces
